standing_statement: Descriptive table of recorded validation-period (VAL, days 122-151) predictions. Every model was tuned on VAL (early stopping, epoch selection or thresholds) except where stated for F. No held-out (TEST) comparison exists, TEST is sealed, and nothing here supports a claim of generalization, statistical significance, causal attribution, fraud or coordination.
f_banner: F rows are on a distinct evaluation basis: the shared checkpoint was trained on days 1-111, the threshold came from TRAIN days 112-121, and the adaptive arm updates on already-scored VAL labels. F is not comparable with A, C, D or E.

b_row.note: no artifact exists (no graph-feature XGBoost); the historical-feature baseline is a different construct and is not substituted; H2 cannot be assessed from this table
